run_DataPipeline_process: run the DataPipeline process method to execute MSA and template search on all chains in a folding input
run_DataPipeline_process_protein_chain: run the process_protein_chain method to get MSA and templates for a single protein chain
run_DataPipeline_process_rna_chain: run the process_rna_chain method to get MSA for a single RNA chain using Nhmmer
create_DataPipelineConfig: create a DataPipelineConfig with binary paths, database paths, and max template date for the AlphaFold data pipeline
run_get_protein_msa_and_templates: run the cached _get_protein_msa_and_templates function to get unpaired MSA, paired MSA, and templates for a protein sequence
